components.css: :host{--bg:#ede6d6;--card:#faf6ec;--inner:#f3eddd;--ink:#16140f;--muted:#625d51;--line:#16140f;--hair:rgba(22,20,15,.14);--track:#e4dbc6;--blue:#3a4df7;--yellow:#f7dc6a;--pink:#f3b6d3;--peri:#bac6f7;--sage:#c4e2b6;--orange:#ef6b2c;--side:#100f0b;--btn-bg:#16140f;--btn-fg:#faf6ec;--display:'Bricolage Grotesque','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--body:'DM Sans','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);--r-card:28px;--r-inner:20px}.ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);border:1.5px solid var(--btn-bg);border-radius:999px;padding:12px 20px;font:600 15px/1.5 var(--body);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s}.ds-btn:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 18px -10px rgba(22,20,15,.6)}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-circ{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--yellow);color:#16140f;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-right:-8px}

narrative.overview:
ShieldWise reads like a well-kept paper ledger that someone has gone over with a felt pen and a set of highlighters. The ground is warm cream paper; every card and control is drawn with a confident ink outline; pastel fields mark which risk you are looking at; one electric blue says what insurance pays and what you can do. The black sidebar is the binder spine that holds it together.

Density is moderate and calm: large rounded cards on an 18px rhythm, generous internal padding, one huge Bricolage numeral per hero, and short plain-English copy in DM Sans. Numbers are the protagonists and are always set in the display face. Depth comes from ink lines and three tonal paper steps, not from shadows.

The world is inherited from the original ShieldWise prototype and extended, not replaced. It ships light and dark themes from the same token names.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground, cream cards, darker cream wells: three tonal steps of the same paper.
1px soft borders on cards and outer controls at rest, stronger on hover; 1.5px ink reserved for checkboxes and pressed states.
Everything interactive is a full pill; every container is a large rounded rectangle.
Pastel fields identify risk categories; text on a pastel is always ink.
Electric blue is reserved for coverage, the action field, and focus.
Bricolage Grotesque for every number and heading, tight negative tracking, tabular figures.

rules.name: The Blue Pays Rule
rules.body: Electric blue means coverage, action, or focus. It is never a decorative fill, and a blue bar always means money a policy would pay.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Pastel Rule
rules.body: Text on any pastel or on yellow/orange is ink (#16140f) in both themes. Pastels do not invert in dark mode.

rules.name: The One Tone Per Category Rule
rules.body: A category's pastel is set once in data and reused everywhere that category appears. Never assign a pastel for decoration.

rules.name: The Numbers Wear Bricolage Rule
rules.body: Every multiplier, dollar amount, price, count and delta is set in Bricolage Grotesque with negative tracking and tabular figures. Body numerals inside sentences may stay in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no tracked-out small caps. Labels are sentence case at 12-12.5px, weight 600.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. A shadow means hover, selection or a floating layer.

dos: **Do** give cards and outer controls a 1px soft border that strengthens on hover; use the hairline only for dividers inside a card.
**Do** nest paper steps: paper ground, cream card, darker well inside.
**Do** set every number in Bricolage Grotesque 600 with negative tracking and tabular figures.
**Do** use the full pill (999px) for every button, field, tag and segmented control.
**Do** give each category one pastel tone from data and reuse it everywhere that category appears.
**Do** keep ink text on pastels, yellow and orange in both themes.
**Do** reserve electric blue for coverage fills, the action field, focus and rare commit buttons.
**Do** use soft negative-spread shadows only for hover, selection and floating layers.
**Do** honor reduced motion; every transition collapses to near zero.
donts: **Don't** use grey or low-contrast outlines on cards; the line is ink.
**Don't** use blue as a decorative fill or for anything other than coverage, action or focus.
**Don't** put white text on a pastel.
**Don't** add uppercase, letter-spaced labels or eyebrow lines above headings.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or shadows at rest.
**Don't** introduce square corners on containers; radii step down with nesting, never to zero.
**Don't** use the serif outside verbatim policy wording.
